summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY building the hardware and embedded software that edge AI runs on. Integrated multi-sensor robotic systems on NVIDIA Jetson, STM32 and Raspberry Pi, with bare-metal C microcontroller firmware, Linux systemd services and TensorRT inference optimization (5.2× speedup). Comfortable at the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and EAGLE PCB design, and in C/C++ and Python.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition in a laboratory environment; used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative analysis.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (Type=simple, auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration; configured XRDP for remote desktop administration of the headless Jetson.

Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
